Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000548" [constraint]: Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000377": The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000373": The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: authentication gateway, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000138": The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000542": The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000448" [decision]: The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000291" [decision]: For anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000271": The image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000103" [decision]: Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000092": The Ember team is currently a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000639" [decision]: Yuki Tanaka is on call for the Cinder team this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000491": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler's runbook.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000454": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000405": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher's runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000150": Oskar runs the weekly architecture review.  (about: Oskar, weekly architecture review)
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000575": INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000551": Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined team Dune on 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, team Dune)
Existing entity names: authentication gateway, Boreal team, the dependency bump, Ember team, job scheduler, Oskar, image resizer, webhook dispatcher, Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego, Farah, Lena, billing API, weekly architecture review, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade, INC-2025-017, the cache change, ledger service, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, team Dune, notifier
